# Task call parameters and return annotations against Chapter 5's durable
# static rules: "A task's parameters are identifiers, not patterns or a rest
# parameter, and its annotation leaves the `R` slot out (`EK5501`)." VIP-55:
# "The `R` slot of `call` is never written." Found by FuzzDurableCallSignatures;
# each key fails in every home (body or bodyless, exported, after an option,
# .vibe or .vibex) and with every typed identifier parameter list.
FuzzDurableCallSignatures task-accepted:a-e-never compiler VIP-55: a task call annotated number!string!never draws no EK5501, although the annotation writes the R slot (the signature check exempts a never R slot)
FuzzDurableCallSignatures task-accepted:a-never compiler VIP-55: a task call annotated number!!never draws no EK5501, although the annotation writes the R slot
FuzzDurableCallSignatures task-accepted:effect-a-e-never compiler VIP-55: a task call annotated Effect.Effect<number, string, never> draws no EK5501, although the annotation writes the R slot
FuzzDurableCallSignatures task-accepted:group-a-e-service compiler VIP-55: a task call annotated (number!string!Users) draws no EK5501: the parentheses hide the written service R slot that number!string!Users is rejected for
FuzzDurableCallSignatures corpus:task-written-never-r-slot compiler reproduction of task-accepted:a-e-never, a task call annotated number!string!never
FuzzDurableCallSignatures corpus:task-parenthesized-service-r-slot compiler reproduction of task-accepted:group-a-e-service in a .vibex file
